guarantees.claim: When msg_strb matches one of 8 contiguous-byte-strobe patterns (7'b000_0000 to 7'b111_1111), funcpad_data[0] is assigned a 64-bit value formed by concatenating end_of_block, a zero-extended funcpad field, and a lower slice of msg_buf[0]. The funcpad extension width is (63 − 8×popcount(msg_strb)) bits and the msg_buf slice width is 8×popcount(msg_strb) bits, keeping the total width at 64 bits.
When msg_strb does not match any of the 8 enumerated contiguous-byte-strobe patterns, the entire funcpad_data array is unconditionally assigned to all zeros via the default branch.

assumptions.claim: msg_strb is expected to only present contiguous-byte-strobe patterns (ones from bit 0 upward) during functional operation and will never carry non-contiguous values such as 7'b000_0010 or 7'b101_0101.
assumptions.risk: A non-contiguous or unexpected msg_strb value matches the default branch, which zeroes the entire funcpad_data array. This could discard valid padding state held in other array elements and corrupt the SHA3 padding sequence before absorption.

uncertain_points.claim: In the 8 enumerated msg_strb branches, only funcpad_data[0] is assigned, while the default branch assigns the entire funcpad_data array. If funcpad_data has more than one element (index > 0), those other elements are left undriven in the enumerated branches within the same always_comb block, inferring combinational latches in synthesis that may retain stale or X values from a previous cycle for those lanes.
uncertain_points.cond: msg_strb matches an enumerated pattern AND funcpad_data has multiple elements
uncertain_points.risk: Stale or uninitialized padding lane values from other funcpad_data elements could propagate into the SHA3 absorption datapath, causing incorrect hash computation or leaking residual state as padding material.

uncertain_points.claim: The default branch aggressively zeroes the entire funcpad_data array on unexpected msg_strb values. It is unclear whether this is an intentional safety/security wipe-on-error behavior or an unintended side effect that silently discards data without raising an error indicator.
uncertain_points.cond: msg_strb takes an unexpected value at runtime
uncertain_points.risk: If unintended, it can corrupt a multi-block SHA3 padding sequence without detection. If intended as a security wipe, the lack of an accompanying alert or error signal may hide a protocol violation from the system.
